name: Cazul
summary: In the Cleft of Shadow, Cazul guides young warlocks toward command of demons. Though blind and ancient, he keeps old orc warlock traditions alive.

sections.title: Eyes in the Dark
sections.body: Beneath Orgrimmar, Cazul waits in the Cleft of Shadow to counsel rising warlocks. Though blind, he senses the Twisting Nether's currents and hears demons whisper. Those who seek to master their craft and bind more dangerous servitors are often sent to him. His arcane power remains.

faq.answer: Cazul is an elderly, blind orc warlock living in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He advises aspiring warlocks in dark sorcery and demonology.

aliases: how did cazul lose his sight
faq.answer: No record tells why Cazul is blind.

faq.q: What role does Cazul play for warlocks?
faq.answer: Cazul guides warlocks advancing their craft, especially those learning to summon and bind a succubus.

angles.text: As a warlock of the Horde, you can seek Cazul's guidance in the Cleft of Shadow when you want to bind deeper powers from the Nether.
As an orc, you can see in Cazul the enduring presence of dark magic among your people. He practices away from the watchful eyes of Thrall's honor guard.
